LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_CelestialUmbili: Grows a living orbital tether by consuming hemogel power from the colony network.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusStartDesc: Awakens the umbilicus and begins growth. It needs {0} total growth work; current flow is {1} hemogel/h and can be raised up to {2} hemogel/h.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusStartWarning: Awakening the celestial umbilicus cannot be cancelled. It will consume hemogel power from the network until {0} growth work is complete. Current flow: {1} hemogel/h; maximum flow: {2} hemogel/h. Every non-player faction will turn hostile. Continue?
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusAwakenedLetterText: The celestial umbilicus has opened its vascular throat to the sky. {0} factions recognize the colony as a planetary infection and turn hostile. Growth required: {1}. Current flow: {2} hemogel/h; maximum flow: {3} hemogel/h.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusDestroyedLetterText: The budding column has been destroyed. The final growth has failed, but the factions that saw the colony's intent will not forget it.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectDormant: Growth flow set to {0} hemogel/h. Awaiting growth command.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectStalled: Growth stalled: the hemogel network is not supplying power.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusNotPlayerOwned: The umbilicus must belong to the player colony.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusAlreadyActive: Only one celestial umbilicus can exist on this map.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusVictoryIntro: The planet was never a home. It was a womb, a sack of minerals, water, memory, and meat. The colony's roots drank it until the last organ learned to pull upward.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusVictoryEnding: The last structures fold inward. Flesh terrain peels from the world, and every colony pawn enters the celestial umbilicus. The colony buds free as a small living moon, carrying {0} absorbed pawns within one orbital organism.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusFlowBarTooltip: Sets how much hemogel power the umbilicus requests from the network while growing. Range: {0}-{1} hemogel/h. Current request: {2}/h; effective supplied growth: {3}/h.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonFormedLetterText: The celestial umbilicus has formed a small living moon beside the planet. Decide whether to absorb the colony into it or preserve a permanent link.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonDecisionCommandDesc: Choose whether the colony buds into the flesh moon or maintains the celestial umbilicus as a permanent link.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectAwaitingChoi: Flesh moon formed. Awaiting a final decision.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectAbsorbing: Absorbing the colony into the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectAscended: The colony has become the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusInspectSevered: The flesh moon link has been severed.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonLinkSeveredLetterText: The celestial umbilicus was destroyed. The flesh moon remains in orbit, but its link to the colony has been lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonChoiceText: The flesh moon is complete. The colony can now surrender all of its biomass and bud away from the planet, ending this story, or keep the celestial umbilicus active and retain access to future lunar functions.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonChoiceAscend: Absorb the colony and bud off
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonLinkedLetterText: The celestial umbilicus has stabilized into a permanent portal. Colonists, fleshbeasts, prisoners, and supplies can now be sent between the colony and the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonMissingSourceMap: The colony map is no longer available.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonAbsorptionStartedLetterText: The colony is folding into the celestial umbilicus. Structures and hemogel organs are consumed, flesh terrain peels inward from the map edges, and every player pawn is drawn toward the forming moon.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusPortalSevered: The celestial umbilicus link has been severed.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusPortalCreateFailed: Failed to stabilize the celestial umbilicus into a portal.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectViewUmbilicusDesc: Jump to the celestial umbilicus that anchors the flesh moon link.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectViewMoonMapDesc: Jump to the generated interior map of the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectNoUmbilicus: The celestial umbilicus is no longer available.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectMoveDesc: Choose a surface tile and send the flesh moon drifting toward it. The surface umbilicus must be detached first.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectAnchorDesc: Load the surface tile below the flesh moon, pause the game, and choose the exact impact site for the celestial umbilicus.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectDetachDesc: Sever the current surface umbilicus and remove its ground-side edge without moving the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectInactiveDisabled: The flesh moon is not active.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectAbsorbingDisabled: The flesh moon is absorbing the colony.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectMovingDisabled: The flesh moon is already moving.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectMoveLinkedDisable: Detach the surface umbilicus before moving the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectAnchorMovingDisab: The flesh moon must finish moving before it can anchor.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectAnchorIncomingDis: The celestial umbilicus is already falling toward the chosen site.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectAnchorLinkedDisab: The flesh moon is already anchored.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectNoLinkedUmbilicus: The flesh moon has no active surface umbilicus.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectNoSurfaceTile: The flesh moon has no surface tile below it.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectTargetImpassable: The flesh moon cannot anchor above impassable world terrain.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusPlacementStarted: Choose the celestial umbilicus impact site on the loaded map. Right-click or Esc cancels placement.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusPlacementWrongMap: Return to the loaded surface below the flesh moon to choose an umbilicus site.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusPlacementThickRoof: The umbilicus cannot pierce thick overhead mountain.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusIncomingStarted: The celestial umbilicus drops from the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonAnchorFailed: Failed to anchor the celestial umbilicus.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonSettlementAnchorLetterText: The celestial umbilicus has pierced {0}, opening a surface portal inside the settlement. This is an attack; expect immediate resistance.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonInspectAnchoring: The celestial umbilicus is falling toward the surface.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonSurfaceAnchorInspectUnlinked: The flesh moon link is inactive.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectUmbilicusRegrowin: A new celestial umbilicus is still growing.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObjectUmbilicusMissingD: The celestial umbilicus must be regrown inside the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRetractionStarted: The celestial umbilicus is retracting. Remaining time: {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusReadyInspect: Collapsed celestial umbilicus ready for deployment.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusMissingInspect: The surface umbilicus was severed. Start regrowth to replace it. Upkeep while growing: {0}/h.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRegrowthStalledInsp: Regrowth stalled: the flesh moon has no hemogel to feed it.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRegrowthAlreadyRead: The celestial umbilicus is already ready.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRegrowthAlreadyActi: The celestial umbilicus is already regrowing.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRegrowthStarted: Celestial umbilicus regrowth started. Umbilicus upkeep increased to {0}/h.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonUmbilicusRegrowthCommandDesc: Start growing a replacement umbilicus inside the flesh moon. It takes three days and raises umbilicus upkeep to {0}/h; if it cannot be fed, growth stalls.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonStarvationLetterText: The flesh moon has exhausted its hemogel reserve while its lunar hemogel balance is {1}/h. Feed it or restore a non-negative balance within {0}, or it will fall onto the surface below.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonStarvationCountdown: Flesh moon collapse countdown: {0} remaining; balance {1}/h.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashedLetterText: The starving flesh moon has fallen onto the surface below. Living creatures on the impact map vanish without corpses, player pawns are thrown into the center, and exposed terrain and things are buried under fresh and rotten flesh.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashUnavailable: The flesh moon cannot fall now.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashNoSurfaceTile: The flesh moon has no valid surface tile below it.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashFailed: Failed to generate the flesh moon impact map.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonInspectCrashed: The flesh moon has fallen onto the surface.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashDevDesc: Immediately drop the flesh moon onto the surface tile below it.
